offers_products.reason: Main offerings are internet access, billboard advertising and surety insurance, which are services rather than goods.

offers_services.reason: Broadband internet service, outdoor advertising and surety insurance underwriting are its main offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Broadband subsidiaries (AireBeam, InfoWest, Fiber Fast Homes) sell home internet to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Billboards sell to advertisers, surety bonds to contractors, and broadband to businesses and builders.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly internet subscriptions, recurring billboard leases and renewing surety policies produce ongoing revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home internet is a near-essential monthly service. Billboards and surety are more cyclical, but broadband is larger.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly internet fees, ad rentals and bond premiums.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the fiber and wireless networks, billboard structures and insurance capital, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main broadband customers are households and small businesses, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Fiber and wireless network build-out and billboard structures need ongoing capital investment.

notes: Mix of broadband, billboards and surety insurance; answers lean on broadband, which is likely the largest part.
